description:
Hi, I'm Charyhan from Mary city, a high school student who loves robotics. I built an automatic trash detector that identifies the type of trash and opens the correct lid, and I use AI tools to turn ideas into working prototypes fast.

For this hackathon, we're building the Space Mission Design Game: a browser game where players design a space mission by choosing a rocket, instruments, and power system under real mass, budget, and power limits, then simulate whether it succeeds.
